definitions.explanation: A flat paper container for a letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{封筒|ふうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To put a letter in an envelope.

examples.japanese: {封筒|ふうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: To put a stamp on an envelope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{封筒|ふうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me a white envelope.

notes:
{封筒|ふうとう} is an envelope, from ⟦{封|ふう}→封：noentry⟧ (seal) + ⟦{筒|とう}→筒：noentry⟧ (tube/cylinder).

TYPES OF ENVELOPES:
- ⟦{長形|ながけい}→長形：noentry⟧{封筒|ふうとう}: long envelope
- ⟦{角形|かくけい}→角形：noentry⟧{封筒|ふうとう}: square envelope
- ⟦{茶封筒|ちゃぶうとう}→茶封筒：noentry⟧: brown envelope
- ⟦{窓付|まどつき}き→窓付き：noentry⟧{封筒|ふうとう}: window envelope

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {封筒|ふうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in an envelope
- {封筒|ふうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open an envelope
- {封筒|ふうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to put a stamp on an envelope
- ⟦{封|ふう}→封：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to seal (an envelope)
